purpose: Teach: 悪党/対局/貧血/中性/土砂/憂い/ぞっと/手遅れ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、時代劇の、本気で、絶対、悪党、絶対、像、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on the villains in period dramas was really impressive.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely impressed. Steady eye contact. Slight lean forward. Measured pace, landing on the compliment with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。冷戦時代の、本気で、絶対、対局、絶対、構造、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really tried to dig deep into the Cold War power structures.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Not overstated. Direct, with a slight softening at the end — accepting the praise without deflecting, but also not performing gratitude.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時の、本気で、絶対、貧血、絶対、栄養失調、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: The way you handled the wartime hardship — the malnutrition, the economic collapse — your perspective was genuinely broad and mature.
lines.style: Reflective, almost thinking aloud. Slight pause before 'broad and mature,' like she's finding the right words. Warm undertone of genuine respect.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。社会の、本気で、絶対、中性、絶対、的立場、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to stay balanced and present all sides fairly.
lines.style: Modest but steady. Not rushing the words. A quiet confidence underneath — she knows the work was solid, but she's not claiming too much space.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地理学の、本気で、絶対、土砂、絶対、災害史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And your geography paper on disaster history — the scope of it, the detail — that was really something.
lines.style: Genuinely engaged. Slight emphasis on 'scope' and 'detail' like she's noticing something that impressed her. Warm and present.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。古代詩人の、本気で、絶対、憂い、絶対、文学、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to show how ancient poets understood loss and sorrow in ways that still matter.
lines.style: Earnest, almost vulnerable. Speaking from something she cares about. Quiet conviction. Not performing — just saying what she meant.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 怪奇文学の、本気で、絶対、ぞっと、絶対、する、絶対、表現、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your section on horror literature — how you captured that sense of dread and unease — it was striking.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly reflective. Measured delivery. Lands on 'striking' with warmth, like she's still thinking about what she read.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史的に、本気で、絶対、手遅れ、絶対、になった、絶対、政策、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I focused on how historical negligence — decisions made too late — shaped everything that followed.
lines.style: Serious but not heavy. Direct. A quiet depth underneath — she's talking about something that matters. Steady, no trailing off.
